title: Hong Kong Do-Not-Call Registers: Quick Version

beats.narration: I'm Alice, and this is how to say no to some marketing messages in Hong Kong.
There are three free Do-Not-Call registers, for recorded phone messages, text messages and faxes.
Call the registration hotline, one eight three five zero zero zero, from the number you want to protect, and follow the voice prompts.
Protection starts on the tenth working day.
beats.on_screen: Protection starts on the 10th working day

beats.narration: It won't stop calls from a real person, or from senders you've already agreed to hear from. For those, use the unsubscribe link.
beats.on_screen: Use the unsubscribe link for those

beats.narration: Want to see where else your details are listed? Check your exposure.
